tg3.title: Refresh queued rows when runner status changes
tg3.note: stale queued rows with a Cancel that fails; a different trigger than the picked-up launch. Validity judged 2026-10-17 by code read.

evidence.site: web/src/App.tsx:441 (requests hook keyed on the SSE version only), web/src/App.tsx:446 (queued filter), src/job-requests.ts:158-162 (settleRequestOfLaunch, no event), src/telemetry.ts:456-466 (expiry, no event)
evidence.trigger: The Jobs page is open with a queued request, and the runner refuses it (posts failed to /done) or the launch goes unpicked for 10 minutes and expires, with no other event in between.
evidence.expected: The row leaves the queued list or shows the failure without a reload.
evidence.actual: The status becomes failed without an event row, so the SSE version does not change and JobsPage, which has no timer, keeps the row as queued with Cancel; Cancel then answers 409.
evidence.reasoning: Read the requests hook, the SSE stream (it sends rows of events only) and every path that moves a request off queued: settleRequestOfLaunch, the expiry in telemetry and finishLaunch. None emits an event. Copilot's finding (tg3-r1-a) is the picked-up case, a related trigger, so this stays partial.

tg6.title: Expose replacement Staff for resumable offline owners
tg6.note: Judged 2026-10-17 by code read. The seat said P1; P2 because Resume and the copyable resume command stay on the card.

evidence.site: web/src/App.tsx:1451-1452 (QueuePage filter), web/src/App.tsx:1663-1671 (Start new Staff, unavailable_owner branch of QueueItem), web/src/App.tsx:1509-1515 (ResumeSection)
evidence.trigger: A Staff that owns an open job goes offline after telemetry has read its transcript, so it is resumable; the scheduler raises unavailable_owner and the Client opens Decisions.
evidence.expected: The Start new Staff action this PR adds can be reached for that job.
evidence.actual: QueuePage drops the unavailable_owner card when its owner is resumable. ResumeSection offers only Resume and the resume command, and the new button is rendered only in that dropped card, so it cannot be reached.
evidence.reasoning: The filter predates the PR, but the PR puts its new action only in the card the filter hides. resumeList marks almost every Claude Code or Codex Staff resumable once its transcript is known, so the button mostly shows only before that. Resume still works, so the Client is not stuck in the common case.

tg6.title: Show cancellation errors alongside start progress
tg6.note: Judged 2026-10-17 by code read. The seat said P2; P3 because only an error message is lost and polling still moves the steps.

evidence.site: web/src/App.tsx:1127-1133 (again), web/src/App.tsx:1136-1138 (working branch shows only StartStatus), web/src/App.tsx:1206 (act.error inside the form branch), src/job-requests.ts:243-245 (409 once picked)
evidence.trigger: The Client clicks Cancel while the start is in progress, and the request fails: the runner already took the launch (409) or the network call fails.
evidence.expected: The cancellation error is shown next to the start progress.
evidence.actual: useAction stores the error in act.error and pending stays set, so working stays true; the branch that renders act.error is not mounted and the Client sees nothing.
evidence.reasoning: Read useAction, NewJobPage (again, working) and StartStatus. In the 409 race the 1.5 s poll still advances the steps and removes Cancel, so some feedback remains; on a network error there is none until the form comes back.
